text: ほれ　そのために…　ひつような　どうぐを　わたそう！

structure.jp: ひつような　どうぐを

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.explanation: ために means 'for the sake of' or 'in order to do' what comes before it. そのために = 'for that purpose'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: Changing わたす to わたそう shows the speaker deciding to do it now: 'let me' or 'I'll'. わたそう = 'I'll hand them over'.
